notes.title: Version 1.0.22
notes.notes:
Added: More random color themes
Improved: Can now reorder the levels of a collection via drag & drop
Improved: Applied updated dialog design to editor dialogs
Improved: Increased rendering saturation
Improved: Increased default sight range set in the editor from 512 to 756
Fixed: Issues that arised from bigger font size in some UI elements
Fixed: Shader compilation errors on certain hardware

notes.title: Version 1.0.21
notes.notes:
This update focuses on improved controller support, a complete settings menu overhaul, and numerous fixes.

Added

 Gamma correction and slider to configure gamma value in settings
 Toast message when a controller is connected or disconnected
 Full custom keybinding support for controllers
 Custom keybinding support for self-destruct (default ESCAPE) and start (default ENTER)

Improved

 Overhauled settings menu, now organized into tabs and more structured
 Better menu navigation with keyboard and controller
 Selectboxes and sliders can now be interacted with using keyboard and controller
 Explosions after thresher dies now shake the camera, as in the original
 Added icons to editor level overview entries and removed file endings
 Dynamic sound sources now start playing more quickly
 Increased sound volume of gnats, spiders, and generatrices
 Many instances of a sound being played in short succession should now be handled better
 Better controller support
 Reduced installation size
 Glows now blend additively

Fixed

 Workshop tab having a line below it when selected
 Thresher incorrectly dying after invulnerability wears off
 Thresher look direction smoothing being FPS dependent
 Sound interpolation being FPS dependent
 Explosions that spawn Unids not playing the correct explosion sound
 Not every unid making a sound when picked up consecutively at higher game speeds
 Skipping when navigating menus with keyboard and controller
 Disabled menu control when assigning a new keybind
 Certain glows being affected by explosions

notes.title: Version 1.0.20
notes.notes:
Fixed: Bug when collecting falling powerups from below while invulnerable
 Fixed: Certain sounds not playing as consecutively as expected
 Fixed: Level list scrolling too much at once with a lot of entries
 Fixed: Being able to incorrectly place mines below falling objects

notes.title: Version 1.0.19
notes.notes:
Added: Editor Help Dialog
Improved: Now built on libGDX 1.13.0 and Java 17 which brings some fixes and performance improvements
Improved: Validation Warning Dialog Message
Improved: A currently running net request is now cancelled if another one of the same type is run in quick succession
Improved: Record submission speed at the end of a level
Fixed: Gravity direction not being restored properly when loading from checkpoint
Fixed: Close incoming objects/missiles not being destroyed by a missile fired at them by tresher
Fixed: Missile collisions sometimes not being cleared correctly
Fixed: Keys staying around visually when destroyed by a closing pressure gate
Fixed: Loading Spinner starting to spin late on dialog after finishing level

notes.title: Version 1.0.18
notes.notes:
Improved: All levels of a collection must now have preview images to be published
Improved: Pressure Plate now looks properly square
Improved: Opened Pressure Gate is now shown
Improved: Better shader performance
Fixed: Bombs exploding in reversed gravity if something was falling behind them
Fixed: Mine not sticking to surface in reversed gravity
Fixed: Level Records sometimes being sorted incorrectly
Fixed: Level Records scrolling horizontally
Fixed: Loading Spinner not spinning on Level Finished Dialog
Fixed: Certain actions not invalidating level
Fixed: Long collection names increasing button width
Fixed: Crash when creating a level with non-ASCII username

notes.title: Hotfix Update 1.0.17
notes.notes:
Fix achievement crash
 Fix gravity switches not being synchronized

notes.title: Version 1.0.16
notes.notes:
We’re continuing to update Oxrox, with more features planned for future releases. This update adds Steam Rich Presence support, some new achievements, leaderboard improvements and several bug fixes.


Added: Steam Rich Presence Support - now showing what level is being played or if in editor
Added: Number of ranks to leaderboard
Added: Global Leaderboard for official levels
Added: New achievements Lab Rat Prodigy and Contributor
Added: Game integrity verification
Improved: Server performance for leaderboard queries
Fixed: Objects stacking in portal exit
Fixed: Different gameplay behavior in reversed gravity
Fixed: Gravity switch having wrong direction after loading checkpoint
Fixed: Opened pressure gate disappearing after loading checkpoint
Fixed: Crash when deleting levels in editor
Fixed: Menu being cut off on low width displays, e.g. Steam Deck

notes.title: Version 1.0.15
notes.notes:
Just a small update with some bugfixes and original music option.


 Added: Setting to choose original music
 Fixed: Sound volume not affecting positional sounds
 Fixed: Some more bugs with secret objects

notes.title: Version 1.0.14
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the release of Version 1.0.14, which consists mainly of bug fixes and small improvements.


Added: Ability to move levels to trash within the editor
Added: Option to restart level from Finished-Dialog using restart hotkey
Added: Level Browser entry in the editor's "View" menu
Added: Controller Dead Zone setting
Added: Hint for using ALT + ENTER to toggle fullscreen mode
Improved: Dialogs remain centered when the window is resized
Improved: Enhanced support for low-width window sizes
Improved: Local record replaced if server record for a level is better
Improved: Tooltip explaining game speed implications
Fixed: Loss of UI control when switching to windowed mode in settings
Fixed: Various glitches with secret objects
Fixed: Incorrect display of level times loaded from the server on the level button
Fixed: Camera getting stuck in a shaken orientation
Fixed: Crash when using ESC/ENTER in quick succession after collecting a checkpoint
Fixed: Being rerouted to the play menu if entering settings before levels are loaded
Fixed: Settings menu getting cut off when scrolling is enabled
Fixed: Editor level being selected when returning to play menu from the editor

notes.title: Version 1.0.12
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing OxRox! We are excited to announce a small update that enhances accessibility, resolves some minor bugs, and includes server improvements. We are aware of the issues with the Linux version and are working to address them soon.


 Added: Accessibility Setting - Disable cursor catching
 Improved: Steam name now used as the level author
 Improved: Usernames for Steam IDs retrieved via server
 Fixed: Highlight for your own leaderboard time
 Fixed: Leaderboard times no longer cut off
 Fixed: Secret collection unlocking
 Fixed: Correct cursor pointer for the Discord button
